prompt: Implement the `vcenter` Go package described in `README.md`. The package must submit the task form of the vCenter VM clone operation, then poll the returned task through every non-terminal state until it succeeds or fails. Treat PENDING, RUNNING, and BLOCKED as non-terminal. Use only the two operations in `docs/contract.json`, preserve the exact REST wire contract, and omit every unset optional request field rather than serializing empty values. Add table-driven tests and make the complete project pass `go test -race ./...`. Do not contact a live VMware endpoint; use the supplied loopback mock.
title: Poll an asynchronous vCenter VM clone to completion
